title: Nurani Qaida (Ahsanul Qawaid)
description:
Online Nurani Qaida (Ahsanul Qawaid) Course

Duration: 72 Hours | 29 Lessons + Exercises

Service Highlights:

  • Comprehensive Learning: A detailed 72-hour online course designed to teach Nurani Qaida (Ahsanul Qawaid) for beginners and those looking to improve their recitation of the Qur'an.
  • 29 Lessons with Exercises:
  • Step-by-step lessons covering all essential aspects of Qaida with practical exercises to reinforce learning.
  • Focused on perfecting pronunciation and understanding of Arabic letters, sounds, and words.
  • Learning Six Kalimahs:
  • Clear instructions on memorizing the Six Kalimahs (important declarations of faith in Islam).
  • Imaan-e-Mufassal & Imaan-e-Mujmal:
  • Teachings on the Two Types of Faith (Imaan-e-Mufassal & Imaan-e-Mujmal) to build strong Islamic beliefs.
  • Tasbihat-e-Salaat:
  • Learn and understand the Tasbihat (Praises of Allah) recited during Salaat (prayer) to enrich your daily worship.
  • Wudhu & Salaah Procedure:
  • Detailed guidance on the correct procedure of performing Wudhu (Ablution) and offering Salaah (prayer) in accordance with Islamic teachings.
  • Practical tips and demonstrations for proper execution and common mistakes to avoid.
  • Personalized Attention:
  • One-on-one online sessions allowing for personalized feedback and support.
  • Flexible scheduling to accommodate your needs.

Why Choose This Course?

  • In-depth, easy-to-follow instructions suitable for all ages and learning paces.
  • Learn the fundamentals of Islamic rituals and prayers in a structured and supportive online environment.
  • Opportunity for individual attention to ensure mastery of the material.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the course?
faqs.answer: The course lasts for 72 hours in total, which includes 29 lessons covering Nurani Qaida. In addition to the 29 lessons, the course also includes other important teachings such as the Six Kalimahs, Imaan-E-Mufassal & Imaan-E-Mujmal, Tasbihat-E-Salaah, and the proper procedures for Wudhu and Salaah.

faqs.question: What are the 29 lessons about?
faqs.answer:
The 29 lessons focus primarily on Nurani Qaida, which includes:

~ Arabic letters and pronunciation
~ Correct recitation techniques
~ Understanding and practicing the sounds of the Qur'anic Arabic

These lessons are designed to help you become proficient in reading and reciting the Qur'an correctly. They are the core of the course.

faqs.question: What else is included in the course besides the 29 lessons?
faqs.answer:
The course offers much more than just the 29 Qaida lessons. The following additional elements are also included:

~ Six Kalimahs: Clear guidance on memorizing the six important declarations of faith in Islam.
~ Imaan-E-Mufassal & Imaan-E-Mujmal: Detailed explanations and memorization techniques for the two types of Islamic faith.
~ Tasbihat-E-Salaah: Learning and understanding the praises of Allah that are recited during the prayer (Salaah).
~ Wudhu & Salaah Procedures: Correct methods of performing Wudhu (Ablution) and offering Salaah (prayer), with a focus on common mistakes to avoid and the proper steps to follow.
~ Exercises will be provided after each lesson to practice.

faqs.question: What kind of support will I receive during the course?
faqs.answer: You will receive personalized support throughout the course. Whether you're working on your Qaida lessons, memorizing the Six Kalimahs, or learning about Wudhu and Salaah, I will be available to answer questions and provide feedback to help you succeed.
